scope: Same retained executable, fixed clients. Plaintext native WebSocket versus encrypted QUIC/WebTransport. Local shared-host loopback, matched workload and CPU masks. Capacity kernel socket snapshots taken at gates; CPU/latency is one pair, not a repeated estimate. RSS excludes kernel. Requested socket buffer limits are not allocations. Kernel accounting is incomplete and skmem counters are not all additive.
kernel_slab_note: Initial unprivileged slab reads were unavailable. Separate read-only sudo query after runs on the same running kernel supplies object sizes; original receipts are preserved. Estimates exclude slab allocator overhead, socket inode structures and other kernel resources.

retirement_conclusion: Five-second full-size WT observation: 2294516240 free arena bytes, 11654640 used arena bytes, 60985456 mmap bytes, RSS2259.21MiB and zero session/resource gauges. The multi-gigabyte post-retirement RSS plateau is mostly allocator-retained free storage; active 100k-session memory remains genuinely large. No trimming or allocator tuning performed.
